correctness.rationale: The exact edge Gram matrix has only nearest-neighbor inner products. Expanding each pending edge row backwards through earlier projections yields two monotone predecessor chains with coefficients \(2^{-k}\), and their norm gives exactly \(1-S_L-S_R\) of squared Frobenius decrease. Telescoping yields the run identity; strict increase of S_k and strict superadditivity of run costs give min, max and equality classes. The proof covers every \(n\ge2\); the embedded Fraction checker executed 8200 exact cases as independent computational consistency tests, not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: For a natural finite-budget graph-averaging and path-incidence Kaczmarz task, the complete exact all-order classification yields an actionable optimum, an exact worst-case policy, and a sharp asymptotic \(4/3\) squared-error penalty from poor ordering. Its contribution is the all-permutation run-length law rather than a parameter renaming or minor numerical example. Relevant limits and the distinct long-time/worst-direction problems are stated.
